You have not because you ask not, or you ask amiss.
#BlackLivesMatter is a stmt. Put action to the stmt.
Register2Vote. Vote. Hold politicians accountable.
Tell Politicians what it is you want and when you want it.
No Exceptions!

@kasie @GeoffRBennett @jonallendc Feb. America's Black History month of the year. Where does America stand this day when it comes to Black Folk? We're gonna find out just how much #BlackLivesMatter to Media, F500s, Government, Educators, Clergy, Courts, LawEnforcement in USA, this Feb. No accidents in politics.

To Mother and family of #Christopherkalonji. Prayers UP! Remember Christopher in the things that would have pleasured him. Know that Americans work daily to not let one part of America off the hook. #BlackLivesMatter

We hear you. We see you. We feel you. We kneel. We protest. We tweet. We pray. We donate time. We donate money. We build better communities. We vote. We ushered in a #BlueWave2018 to give you peace. Keep talking to us 🗣️Remind America! #BlackLivesMatter #BlackHistoryMonth 2019.

@RepBarbaraLee @stellabystarlit Model role models in spite of various obstacles they worked under and overcome and was able to soar as none before them had ever before done. This is who was are. #BlackHistoryMonth 2019 #BlackLivesMatter

African Americans 400 years in a strange land shall be vindicated this year. African Americans shall receive the grace of God and shall for the very first time know #BlackLivesMatter . Black folk shall forgive and forget.

🙏RIP Waldorf. Every mother's child deserves better than this. Give of yourself this year good people. Improve your life. Where ever you lack, repair &launch better futures starting today. #400YrsIsUp, Every Waldorf deserves better. Commit &prove this year, #BlackLivesMatter

@Backstorymom1 @nbcwashington A sincere apology to the family of Walter Eugene Thomas. I misread the tweet &listed his name, Waldorf. Condolences to Ms. Shenna Foster. As you grieve know millions of Americans stand w/u. We shall overcome. #BlackLivesMatter is the tip of reality. w/o Black there is no life!
